cp3:1.1: Punāparaṃ yadā homi Indapatte pur' uttame rājā Dhanañjayo nāma kusale dasah' upāgato, || ||
cp3:2.1: Kāliṅgaraṭṭhavisayā brāhmaṇā upagañchu maṃ āyācuṃ maṃ hatthināgaṃ dhaññaṃ maṅgalasammataṃ: || ||
cp3:3.1: Avuṭṭhiko janapado dubbhikkho chātako mahā, dadāhi pavaraṃ nāgaṃ nīlaṃ Añjanasa' vhayaṃ. || ||
cp3:4.1: Na me yācaka-m-anuppatte paṭikkhepo anucchavo mā me bhijji samādānaṃ dassāmi vipulaṃ gajaṃ. || ||
cp3:5.1: Nāgaṃ gahetvā soṇḍāya bhiṅkāre ratanāmaye jalaṃ hatthe ākiritvā brāhmaṇānaṃ adaṃ gajaṃ. || ||
cp3:6.1: Tassa nāge padinnamhi amaccā etad-abravuṃ: kin-nu tuyhaṃ varaṃ nāgaṃ yācakānaṃ padassasi, || ||
cp3:7.1: Dhaññaṃ maṅgalasampannaṃ saṅgāmavijay' uttamaṃ. Tasmiṃ nāge padinnamhi kin-te rajjaṃ karissatīti. || ||
cp3:8.1: Rajjam-pi me dade sabbaṃ sarīraṃ dajjam-attano sabbaññutaṃ piyaṃ mayhaṃ tasmā nāgaṃ adās' ahan-ti. || ||
